seo.home: Free ARC Raiders tools: map event schedule, interactive loot and ARC spawn maps, quest tracker, craft calculator, looting helper and stash planner.
seo.schedule: ARC Raiders map event schedule: see which map conditions like Night Raid or Electromagnetic Storm are active on each map now and which come next.
seo.craftCalculator: ARC Raiders craft calculator: work out how many items to craft from your materials to squeeze the most space out of your stash.
seo.quests: ARC Raiders quest tracker: every trader quest in an interactive tree, with the maps they take place on and their blueprint rewards. Track your progress.
seo.lootHelper: ARC Raiders looting helper: follow the crafting chains behind each item to know which materials are worth looting during raids.
seo.quartermaster: ARC Raiders Quartermaster: plan your stash, loadouts and hideout upgrade requirements in one place.
seo.maps: Interactive ARC Raiders maps: find where to loot any item and where ARC enemies spawn, on every map and for every map condition.
seo.mapSizes: How big is each ARC Raiders map? The playable area of every raid map measured in meters and drawn side by side at the same scale.

help.title: How to Use
help.videoLink: Watch a quick walkthrough: How to Use the Looting Helper
help.step1Body: Use the search bar to find and add items you want to craft regularly. This builds your master list of requirements.
help.step2Body: The app automatically generates a list of all base resources and materials you need to loot to achieve these crafting goals.
help.step3Body: Mark items as already covered in your stash when you have enough of them. This reduces the list to what you still actually need.
help.step4Body: Use the list during or after a raid to quickly decide what to keep, salvage, leave behind, or sell.
help.exampleBody: If you want to craft a specific gadget, add it as a goal. The visualizer shows the full tree from the final item down to base materials like Circuit Boards or Chemicals. When you find a topside item during a raid, you can quickly check which materials it salvages into and decide whether it is worth the inventory space.
help.noteBody: This tool focuses specifically on items needed for crafting. Combine these requirements with whatever you still need for expeditions or projects.
help.learningBody: A key benefit of this tool is learning the relationship between topside items and the materials they provide. As you use it, you develop a better feel for what is valuable and eventually you will know what to keep without needing the tool.

Containers count only when their category matches the item's (Mechanical items in Mechanical containers; plants give only their own item). Spawned containers (ammo boxes, caches, husks) roll server-side tables, shown as “?”.

emperor.title: How to open the Fallen Emperor
emperor.step1: During the Redirection event, activate a Damaged Emperor Relay and take the Emperor Beacon from it.
emperor.step2: Place the beacon on the ground and take cover: debris rains down.
emperor.step3: Breach the large part. It may contain the Emperor Gateway Conduit Blueprint (the blueprint can also lie on the ground during the Frigate event).
emperor.step4: Craft the Emperor Gateway Conduit at the Workbench from the ARC Plated, Insulated and Conductive Couplers.
emperor.step5: Use the conduit to open the Fallen Emperor dungeon on Pendola Pass.
emperor.note: If you extract with the Emperor Beacon, it turns into a Ruined Emperor Beacon.
